nusmp.skill.book_stone.description: The grimoire of Stone Magic: dressed, cut and carved stone. Its pages throw stone, push slabs out of the ground, raise walls and a Stone Sentinel, seal casting with a shockwave and forge the masonry armour over you. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_bolt: A bolt of cut stone: it bursts on the first foe or wall and slows everything it hits.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_cut: Stone slabs are pushed out of the ground one after another along your line of sight, hitting and slowing what stands on them.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_field: A field of rising slabs laid at the aimed point: it hurts everything inside every moment and holds it back.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_domain: A shockwave of stone round you: a great burst that hurls back everything near and, when the control lock is free, seals its casting for a few seconds (Magic Jamming). Forges the masonry armour for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_stone.attribute_guard: Masonry armour: dressed stone blocks forge over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance II, thorns and a share of your aura spent; runed tablets float behind you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_sentinel: A Stone Sentinel rises at your side: a knight of masonry with a tower shield that turns projectiles back and a block hammer that smashes the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_wall: A wall of stone bricks, six wide and four high, raised in front of you for ten seconds.
